spells.name: Internship
spells.description: Place the top three cards of the Room deck in the discard pile. If one of these cards is a Miniboss, you may immediately build it. (In addition to your normal build turn.)

spells.name: Spirit Dragon
spells.description: Choose a Room in any dungeon. Until end of turn, it has one of each treasure type instead of its normal treasure.

spells.name: Sabotage!
spells.description:
Choose a Room. Until end of turn it has no ability text.
OR, if if you have more Minibosses than your opponent, deactivate that Room until end of turn.|

spells.name: Rage!
spells.description: Choose a Miniboss. For every level that Miniboss has, give its Room +1 until end of turn. AND, if you have only one Miniboss, you may then double the damage of that Room.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.description: Yo may discard two Monster Room cards or one Miniboss card to kill one Hero in your dungeon.

spells.name: Rebirth
spells.description: Chose a player (including yourself). That playwe discards their hand and draws Rooms and Spells equal to the number of each they discarded.

spells.name: Smash!
spells.description:
Deal 2 damage to a Hero in your dungeon.
OR deal 4 damage to a Hero in a Room that contains a Miniboss.

spells.name: Pay to Win
spells.description: Choose a Room to gain +1 until end of turn, plus an additional +1 for each (c) you pay when you cast this spell.

spells.name: Zoning Board
spells.description: For your build turn, you may build an Advanced Room on top of any other Room, ignoring matching treasure icon requirements.

spells.name: Respawn
spells.description: Treat all of your Rooms as if they were just built.

spells.name: Heist
spells.description: Choose a Room in any dungeon. Until end of turn end that Room's treasure icons.

spells.name: Short Circuit
spells.description: Choose an opponent casting a spell. Until end of turn, that opponent must pay (c) for each spell they wish to cast. If they don't, that spell is cancelled.

spells.name: Traitor
spells.description: Choose an opponent's Miniboss. You may pay that opponent one (c) per that Miniboss's Level to take it and immediatly build it at that same level. You may not build a room this turn.

spells.name: Armor Up!
spells.description: Give a Hero +1 until end of turn AND give this Hero an additional +2 until end of turn for every (c) you spend when casting this spell.

spells.name: Excavation
spells.description: Choose one Item in any scorekeeping area. You may flip it face-down or face-up.

spells.name: All Your Base
spells.description: View an opponent's hand. You may take one Room card from that opponent.

spells.name: Another Castle
spells.description: Choose a Hero in your dungeon. Send that Hero to the entrance of an opponent's dungeon.

spells.name: Fairy Fountain
spells.description: Choose a Room. Until end of turn, it does zero damage and each Hero entering it gains +1.

spells.name: It's On!
spells.description: Kill one Hero in your dungeon who has 3 or less Health. OR If you have 3 wounds or more, kill one Hero in your dungeon.

spells.name: Hiring Spree
spells.description: Draw three Room cards, then give another player one of your Room cards.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt!
spells.description: Deal 3 damage to one Hero in your dungeon. AND If you discard another Spell card, deal 3 damage to each Hero at the entrance to your dungeon.

spells.name: Meddling Kids!
spells.description: Choose a Room. Until the end of turn, it has no ability text. OR Choose a player. If three or more Heroes entered that player's dungeon this turn, that player cannot win this turn.

spells.name: Oh, Yeah!
spells.description: Swap the placement of two Rooms in your dungeon. OR If two or more of your Rooms have been destroyed this turn, choose and destroy one Room in any dungeon.

spells.name: Party Up
spells.description: Choose a dungeon. Until the end of turn, each Hero entering that dungeon gains +1

spells.name: Pause
spells.description: If there is a Hero in your dungeon, return it to the entrance and restore it to full Health. No Heroes may enter your dungeon until next turn.

spells.name: Pity
spells.description: Choose a Hero in an opponent's dungeon. Remove that Hero from the game.

spells.name: Secret Stash
spells.description: Choose a Room in your dungeon. Until end of turn, give it one extra Cleric, Fighter, Mage or Thief.

spells.name: Shortcut!
spells.description: Choose a Hero in any dungeon. It skips the next Room it would enter. OR If that dungeon has five Rooms, the Hero skips the next two Rooms it would enter.

spells.name: Super Effective!
spells.description: Choose a Room in your dungeon. It deals +2 until end of turn. OR If only one Hero was lured to your dungeon this turn, that Room does +4 until end of turn.

spells.name: Surprise Gift
spells.description: During the Build phase, you may place a Room in an opponent's dungeon instead of your own. (Place it face-down over a face-up Room. Opponent may still place another Room. Any build effects apply to the opponent.)

spells.name: Undead Minion
spells.description: Choose one face-down Hero in your scorekeeping area and remove it from the game. Deal damage equal to that Hero's Health to one Hero in your dungeon.

spells.name: Wild Monster
spells.description: You may immediately build a Monster Room over an existing Room in your dungeon.

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Nick the Masher The young cleric was well-armed, and brave enough to take on the Dragon King himself. His credo: "I bash it with my mace."
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Pugi the Druidess A defender of the wilderness, she wields the power of Nature. Flowers blossom in her footsteps, and life grows anew.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Acacia, Warrior of Light Acacia is a carefree soul who makes her own luck. A strong defender of good, she is undeterred by even the darkest dungeons.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Charles the Young Charles has mother's permission to go adventuring, but he has to return before sundown.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Delatorious, Angel of Light
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Romero, the Indigo Friar He is a dedicated man of the cloth who wants to see the world coated in blue. You might think he's depressed, but he's actually very, very happy.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Fighter
heroes.description: Boden the Pantless Boden's courage is matched only by his forgetfullness. The quest to find his misplaced armor continues!
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Fighter
heroes.description: Jarek, Squire to the Lion Knights As a squire, Jarek loved nothing more than stories and legends. He had no idea that he would someday become one.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Fighter
heroes.description: Fire's Breath, Heroine of Arcadia The scarlet-haired warrior woman known as Fire's Breath has pledged her deadly twin blades to the fight for liberty
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Fighter
heroes.description: Samurai Tom Not truly a samurai, this masterless ronin seeks honor and glory.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Fighter
heroes.description: Johnny of the Evening Watch A humble member of the Evening Watch, whose band o'brothers is sworn to forsake family, take the grey, and clear dungeons.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Fighter
heroes.description: Crystol and A'lan of Gerd Bound by the unbreakable Ring of Gerd, these lovers became the most dangerous husband-wife team in the adventuring business.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Mage
heroes.description: Tieg and the Magic Bubble Armed with his trusty bubble, Tieg braves dangerous castles and dungeons in search of the muscial instruments stolen from his people.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Mage
heroes.description: Brandork the Neverwrong Schooled in seven flavors of magic, Brandork follows the teachings of master Face, the Omniscient Celestial
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Mage
heroes.description: Mitchell, the Judge He has wandered the planes, hopelessly lost... ever since his wife, Nikki, sent him to the store for diamond dust sugar.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Mage
heroes.description: Kalish Ninefingers The worst thief ever, Kalish lost a finger and his freedom in one night. Taught magic in prison by his sorcerous cellmate, he now kills evil with fire.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Mage
heroes.description: Dartteon, Elf Pyromancer Some elves just want to watch the world burn.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Mage
heroes.description: Koey, The Last Dragon Mage The survivor of Drakonia vowed to save the world from Kirax's reign with the power bestowed to him by the last emerald dragon.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Joman Chimm, Cutpurse From the twinkle in his eye, you might think he comes bearing gifts... until you check your empty pockets.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Lance Uppercut, Treasure Hunter With a bent blade and a clenched fist, he gathers shining treasures for the glory of the Keonish Empire.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Jesta the Rogue "Okay, so you take the big guy on the left with the axe, you've got the two little ones on the right with swords, and I'll take this dangerous-looking treasure chest with no lock over here..."
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Kins Klauski, Mad Conquistador "It's hard for me to think about death, how insects and worms will eat me... I never think about death. I haven't even properly started to live yet."
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Sir Digby Apple, Ace Detective He battles to keep the coffers filling, to keep his partners preening and to send a needless message of power to all of the unwilling.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Jerome, Kung Fu Monkey A Visitor from a distant land, his hyperactive monkey studied martial arts under the legendar Sifu Wang.
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: The Fool
heroes.description: The Fool is lured to the dungeon of the Boss Monster with the fewest Souls. (In the case of a tie, he waits in town until the tie is broken.)
heroes.subtitle: Ordinary Hero

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Katelyn, Angelic Healer Among the most exalted defenders of righteousness, Katelyn is sometimes referred to as "altissima luce" -- highest light.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Kerberos Dirtbeard, Canine Cleric Hailing from the Highlands, this flea-bitten friar never turns down a fetch quest.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Lord Van Ette A prophet and collector of tithes for the omniscient Celestial, his "miracles" are enhanced by the brandewijn distilled by the monks of Nintehn.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Cleric
heroes.description: Jejune & Everlea, Holy Sisters Tenacious and vivacious, each is a threat on her own. But woe betide any who stand against the sisters' united power.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Fighter
heroes.description: Frankov, the Envoy This brave warrior stands alone against the evil that rules the world.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Mage
heroes.description: Nate the Squidslayer This surly warrior defeated the mighty Squib, Lord of the Rocktopi. Now he seeks to destroy King Croak himself...
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Mage
heroes.description: Antonius, the Rune Knight An elite dragoon, Sir Tony wears armor inscribed with magic runes of ancient and mysterious power.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Fighter
heroes.description: Asmor the Aweless What Asmor lacks in tactical acuity, he more than makes up for in impulsiveness. There's no door he won't kick down, much to the frustration of Arcadia's innkeepers.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Mage
heroes.description: Tempros the Time Marauder He would use his control over time to end all crime. In his hands, this world could be a utopia.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Chia Kang, Mystical Warlock of Yu "Hey, Listen! I think this Boss Monster is--" "Silence, fairy! I will crush him through fire and flames in the name of the Order!
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Terric Warhelm, Half-Elf Archmage "Weakened by an evil curse, this once-mighty warrior donned the red robes and turned to magic. His spells are chnneled through a magical helmet of untold power."
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Wayward, the Drifter He is a traveler from a strange land whose only goal is to do whatever is right... whatever that means.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Hya, Legendary Shinobi Arcadia's deadliest ninja,Hya lives by the proverb that revenge is a dish best served cold.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Blackbeard Jake He hid the treasure he won from insult swordfighting in a booty-trap filled cave on the coast of a town called Astoria.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Cecil Leoran, Master Factotum The ultimate jack-of-all-trades, Cecil isn't above taking mercenary work to earn gold and glory. But his real goal has never changed: to find a way to return his betrothed Nevra, sealed into a rapier, to her original form.
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Thief
heroes.description: Wallbanger Basketweaver This humble halfing world rather spend his days weaving baskets and eating crumbly cookies. But when adventure calls, he proves a first-rate burglar
heroes.subtitle: Epic Hero

heroes.name: Crash Dodgers|Crash Dodgers] Hailing from a small blue planet in the galactic backwater, Crash has long been the bane of the alien bosses
Corbin Crickton|Corbin Crickton] An interstellar taxi driver who took one too many lefts at the grand wormhole: now, he's looking through the wreckage of the Crash Landing for a possible way home
T'Matha|T'Matha] A shapeshifting squidopod, T"Matha braves the crash site again and again looking for the Omega 42, the legendary weapon that might free her people from their greatest mistake
Lindo Callari|Lindo Callari] Wanted space vampire, failed ambassador, inveterate gambler
Doug O'Shibe, Ace Pilot|Doug O'Shibe, Ace Pilot] Doug has demonstrated such heroism, so frequently, that he is the most famous starfighter pilot in his galaxy
Guy the Redrobe|Guy the Redrobe] IT support for his clan of saber wielding space monks, Guy did not understand why he had to go on this away mission

Andromeda James|Andromeda James] This intrepid worm-o-naut has burrowed into the galaxy's darkest crypts looking for lost relics, but tales of a crystal skeleton lost in the Crash Landing have brought him to Arcadia
Morgan Fragman|Morgan Fragman] Morgan is a man of many talents: soldier, master chef, and interdimensional physicist
Banzai Barb|Banzai Barb] Intergalactic Jane-of-all-trades, Banzai Barb leads her ragtag group of cavaliers in a neverending war to kick the invaders out of Arcadia
Aliff|Aliff] Orbital Spaceman Aliff couldn't save his world from the Frostmen, but by Mallmax he swore he'd protect this planet, as long as his trusty saber cat Hob'x was by his side
Demigod
heroes.description: The Demigod is lured to the dungeon of the Boss Monster with the fewest Wounds. (in the case of a tie, he waits in town until the tie is broken.)

heroes.name: Monster Hunter
heroes.description: This Hero is lured to the dungeon with the highest combined Fighter and Cleric treasure. Monster Rooms deal -1 damage to this hero.

heroes.name: Trap Master
heroes.description: This Hero is lured to the dungeon with the highest combined Mage and Thief treasure. This Hero ignores all Room ability text. When it is in a dungeon, Room activated abilities cannot be used.

heroes.name: Felicity, Joyful Nurse Felicity is an accomplished hero and sworn pacifist
Wolfhard, Teen Hero This young paladin fights all evil things, both ordinary and strange
Holkin, Propheteer Holkin plays many roles
Luz, Merciful Healer Luz is a fast-paced heroine who brings good vibrations an pwerful healing to any battle
Josie, Vampire Slayer Josie claims to have vanquished hundreds of vampires
Tess, Dwarven Shieldmaiden Tess risked banishment to become an adventurer
Steven the Human For Steve, anytime is the right time to go on an adventure! He may seem like a normal kid, but Steve and his friends will always find a way to save the day
Rotgut, Half-Giant Berserker Rotgut has the strength of his giantess mother, the courage of his human father, and the drinking skills that brought the unlikely pair together
Maxine, Sister of Steel  When her homeland was destroyed by apocalyptic magic, Maxine donned the sealed armor of her ancestors and set out to return order to the land
Joe the Smith From training dragons to building golems, this blacksmith is up for any adventure
Elfstar] Once an acolyte limited to simple orisons, Elfstar is now a true priestess who has mastered the mind bondage spell
Kyle the Incorruptible] This acolyte of the Order declared himself free from sin and immune to temptation
Danae the Slayer] A woman of few words, Danae is relentlessly focused on her mission: to eliminate every undead abomination in Arcadia
Solemn Caine, Pilgrim of Pain|Solemn Caine, Pilgrim of Pain] This zealot has mounted a one-man inquisition into the darkest depths of Arcadia's dungeons
Adynn, Cleric of Love|Adynn, Cleric of Love] The son of a philandering elf, Adynn inherited his father's charm and beauty
Hookshot Joe|Hookshot Joe] Once the commander of an elite fighting unit, he lost his left hand in battle
Tarka, Eskimo Warrior|Tarka, Eskimo Warrior] This northern warrior will not rest until he finds his best friend
Lady Samantha|Lady Samantha] Her skills as a weaponsmith made Lady Samantha one of the wealthiest nobles in Arcadia
Ampersand the Galled|Ampersand the Galled] This dwarven warrior is legendary for his prodigious appetite, his puissant skill at arms, and his crazy temper
Damok, Dragon Hunter|Damok, Dragon Hunter] Some regard him as a savage for his primitive weaponry, and his speech consists of cryptic phrases like "Scythe, his face black, his eyes red
Megan the Missile Mage|Megan the Missile Mage] This intrepid adventuress, also known as "the Azure Evoker," is not your typical wizard
Otus the Occult|Otus the Occult] Otus has seen things that the would drive most mortal men to madness
A Kid and His Spellslime|A Kid and His Spellslime] When an ordinary kid discovered a wounded spellslime, he nursed it back to health with candy
Wink the Probably Magical|Wink the Probably Magical] Wink's apparent lack of magical talent has not stopped him from going on adventures, or referring to his pet chameleon as his "familiar
Iskandar, Ice Mage|Iskandar, Ice Mage] Once a small-town librarian, Iskandar became a hero when he defended his town against a dragon attack
Black Leaf|Black Leaf] Black Leaf is always the first to scout ahead, swing across a chasm, or disable a poins trap
Murphy the Magnificent|Murphy the Magnificent] He was a charlatan, a carnival performer, and a con man
Colgar, Fugitive Prince|Colgar, Fugitive Prince] He lost his kingdom to Cerebellus, but he retains his ancestral weapon

Francisco the Endbringer|Francisco the Endbringer]
This highly trained assassin from the southern Silver Kingdom is known as the "painter or blood
Raymond Two-Chains|Raymond Two-Chains] Once he was an outlaw, notorious for wielding his chain-whips with deadly precision
Tyrone, Pharaoh Ascendant|Tyrone, Pharaoh Ascendant] When Tyrone was young, the temple elders praised his hieroglyphics
Branadin Wordblessed|Branadin Wordblessed] This cosmic chronicler travels tirelessly from world to world, inscribing each people's histories and magics on plates of copper

Heavenboy|Heavenboy]
This son of an angel and a mortal woman was born with clipped wings and half a halo

Lone Fox and Kit|Lone Fox and Kit]
Few know that this mysterious beauty was once a princess

Ser Mortin the Deadly|Ser Mortin the Deadly]
No knight is more celebrated, but do not invite Ser Mortin to your wedding feast

O'Brien the Destroyer|O'Brien the Destroyer]
Every night, he begins a new quest for glory

Dumbledalf the Blue|Dumbledalf the Blue]
In a world of punk-rock pyromancers and spiky haired sorcerers, one man believes in keeping things classic

Wrathfuss the Namer|Wrathfuss the Namer]
Wrathfuss knew the names of most things, and so most things were his to command

Markus, Geomancer Supreme|Markus, Geomancer Supreme]
Once, he lived alone in a flat, infinite world

Rom the Reaver|Rom the Reaver]
No one is faster with a blade, but Rom is a tortured soul

Gaimina, Thief of Dreams|Gaimina, Thief of Dreams]
No door is closed to her, nor any dreaming mind, and she does not fear death

Roberta, Dreaded Outlaw|Roberta, Dreaded Outlaw]
Her life became a nightmare when she was wedded to an evil prince and her true love was slain by a pirate

items.name: Extra Life
items.subtitle: Cleric Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If this Hero would be killed, it returns to town instead. (You get to keep this Item.)
Reward: This turn, you cannot lose due to Wounds. (Another player can still win due to Souls.)

items.name: Holy Hand Grenade
items.subtitle: Cleric Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If this Hero survices your dungeon, you must discard two Room cards at random.
Reward: Each of your opponents must discard one Room card at random.

items.name: Inquisitor's Robes
items.subtitle: Cleric Item
items.description:
Power-Up: Destroy the first Advanced Room that this Hero survives.
Reward: Choose and destroy an Advanced Room in any dungeon.

items.name: Staff of Healing
items.subtitle: Cleric Item
items.description:
Power-Up: Until end of turn, each Hero entering your dungeon has +2
Reward: Heal one ordinary Wound.

items.name: Goblin Suit
items.subtitle: Fighter Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero takes no damage from ordinary Monster Rooms.
Reward: Until end of turn, give all your ordinary Monster Rooms +1

items.name: Claws of the Berserker
items.subtitle: Fighter Item
items.description:
Power-Up: For each Monster Room in your dungeon, this Hero has +1
Reward: Choose a Hero. Until end of turn, for each Monster Room in your dungeon, give that hero +1

items.name: Oversized Sword
items.subtitle: Fighter Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero has +5
Reward: Choose a Hero in any dungeon. Until end of turn, it has +5

items.name: Vorpal Blade
items.subtitle: Fighter Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If this Hero survives your dungeon, until end of turn you have +1 Wound.
Reward: Kill a Hero who has taken damage equal to at least half its Health.

items.name: Antimagic Lizard
items.subtitle: Mage Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If this Hero survives your dungeon, discard two random Spell Cards.
Reward: Choose an opponent. That opponent discards a random Spell Card.

items.name: Ice Rod
items.subtitle: Mage Item
items.description:
Power-Up: Any Room that this Hero survives is deactivated until end of turn.
Reward: Choose a Room in an opponent's dungeon. It is deactivated until end of turn.

items.name: Magic Mirror
items.subtitle: Mage Item
items.description:
Power-Up: Before this Hero enters your dungeon, rearrange your Rooms so their order is reversed.
Reward: Copy the Boss Ability of any face-up Item card.

items.name: Necronomicon
items.subtitle: Mage Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If this Hero survives your dungeon, each of your opponents draws one Spell card.
Reward: Draw a Spell card.

items.name: Bag of Holding
items.subtitle: Thief Item
items.description:
Power-Up: When this Hero survives a ROom with at least two treasure icons, destroy that Room.
Reward: Search the discard pile for a Room with at least two treasure icons and put it into your hand.

items.name: Cheat Code
items.subtitle: Thief Item
items.description:
Power-Up: While this Hero is in your dungeon, ignore all Room ability text in your dungeon.
Reward: Choose a Room in any dungeon. Ignore its ability text until end of turn.

items.name: Ten Foot Pole
items.subtitle: Thief Item
items.description:
Power-Up: When this Hero enters your dungeon, deactivate the first Trap ROom in your dungeon.
Reward: Choose a Trap ROom in any dungeon. Deactivate that Room until end of turn.

items.name: The Bomb
items.subtitle: Thief Item
items.description:
Power-Up: If this Hero enters the last Room of your dungeon, destroy that Room. (It deals no damage.)
Reward: Destroy a ROom in your dungeon: Deal 5 damage to a Hero in that Room.

items.name: Boots of Jumping
items.subtitle: Universal Item
items.description:
Power-Up: Every time this Hero survives a Room, it ignores the next Room it would enter.
Reward: Choose a Hero in any dungeon. It ignores the next Room in that dungeon.

items.name: Pet Monster
items.subtitle: Universal Item
items.description:
Power-Up: When this Hero enters your dungeon, deactivate the first Monster Room in your dungeon.
Reward: Choose a Monster Room in any dungeon. Deactivate that Room until end of turn.

items.name: Star of Invulnerability
items.subtitle: Universal Item
items.description:
Power-Up: This Hero ignores any damage from the first three Rooms of your dungeon.
Reward: Choose a Hero that survived your dungeon this turn. Remove that Hero from the game.

items.name: Ring of Invisibility
items.subtitle: Universal Item
items.description:
Power-Up: While this Hero is in your dungeon or at the entrance to your dungeon, you may not play Spells.
Reward: Cancel a Spell played during your Adventure Phase.

levels.description: This Room has +1.
Once per turn, discard a card to do 2 damage to a Hero in this Room.
Choose a Miniboss. Return that card to its owner's hand. Reset to Level One.
This Room gains +1 Fighter.
Once per turn during the Build phase, you may switch the position of two Rooms in any dungeon.
Give all Monster Rooms in one dungeon +1 or -1 until end of turn. Reset to Level One.
This Room gains +1 Cleric.
Once per turn, you may return a Hero in your dungeon to town.
Look at one opponent's hand. You may take one Spell or Room card from them. Reset to Level One.
You may build any Room on top of this one, regardless of treasure icon.
When a Hero dies in this Room, you may treat another Room in your dungeon as just built.
Give a Hero in any dungeon +5 until end of turn. Reset to Level One.
This Room gains +1 Mage.
When a Hero dies in this Room, you may draw a Spell card.
Choose a dungeon. Heroes ignore all ability text in that dungeon until end of turn. Reset to Level One.
This Room gains +1 Thief.
Once per turn when you gain one or more coins, gain one extra coin.
Kill a Hero in this Room. Reset to Level One.
This Room has +1.
Ignore the ability text of any Heroes or Epic Heroes in, or at the entrance to, your dungeon.
Deactivate a Room in any dungeon until end of turn. Reset to Level One.
This Room has +1 for every treasure icon it has.
Once per turn, you may discard a Spell card to cancel an opponent's Spell.
Choose a dungeon. Until end of turn, Heroes entering that dungeon skip its first room. Reset to Level One.
This Room has +1.
Once per turn when a Hero dies in this Room, draw a Room card. You may immediately build that Room.
Double this Room's damage until end of turn. Reset to Level One.
Draw an extra Room at the beginning of the Build phase, then discard a Room.
Double this Room's treasure value. (It has one extra copy of each printed treasure icon it has.)
Choose a Hero in town. Place it at the entrance to your dungeon. Reset to Level One.
